name: shared-helper-owner-search
goal: Keep helper calls searchable by both their callable names and owning module names.

evidence: 0f7a9504 changed function row names to callable symbols and accidentally dropped owner titles from search. The existing 1000-row responsive console scenario reproduces it at all three viewports.
Focused catalog checks searched callable names only. Extend the shared collection identity matrix to require owner-title search when displayed names differ; the normal Reports unit suite enforces it.
